pairs.registryProposal: upward lesson for advisory-guard-fail-mode: an OBSERVER hook installed machine-wide (into every agent session on the host, not one harness) has a second cost of failing closed beyond a stuck operator - when the observing app is down, every tool call in every unrelated session logs a hook-error pair.
